title: Vesper and the Visitor
author: Cyrus Voss
blurb: Isandro Vasquez, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
